title: Lemon Butter Baked Cod
description: Tender cod fillets baked with lemon, garlic butter and a crisp herby breadcrumb topping. Light, fast and hard to overcook.

image.alt: Baked cod fillets with lemon butter, lemon slices and parsley

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Pat the fish dry, season with the salt and lay it in the baking dish.
Stir the garlic and lemon zest into the melted butter. Spoon half of it over the fish.
Toss the panko and parsley with the rest of the butter and press it over the top of each fillet.
Bake until the fish is opaque and flakes easily and the crumbs are golden, {time 12-15 min}, depending on thickness. It should reach {temp 145F internal}. Serve with the lemon wedges.

notes: Thin fillets cook faster; start checking at 8 minutes.
